locale.description: Language of this catalog, set as the lang attribute of the extension pages.

extDescription.message: Chrome bridge shared by Antigravity, Claude and Codex (NexusBrowser): each agent in its own background tabs.
extDescription.description: Manifest description and Chrome Web Store summary (132 characters at most).

popupBridgeStarts.message: It starts with an agent's first command.

popupGmailCounter.message: Unread Gmail count for the keypad

popupGmailCounterNote.message: (the number only, kept on this PC)

pairHeading.message: Pair the extension with the local bridge

pairIntro.message: Paste the pairing code given by the NexusBrowser app (valid for 5 minutes, once). It only works on this PC and never leaves your computer.

pairInvalidCode.message: Invalid code: 43 characters expected (letters, digits, - and _).

pairKeyNotSaved.message: Pairing accepted by the bridge but the key was not saved ($ERROR$): try again.

pairDone.message: Extension paired with the NexusBrowser bridge. You can close this tab.

pairRefusedDefault.message: connection closed by the bridge (code expired, already used or wrong)

authNotPaired.message: extension not paired: open pairing from the NexusBrowser app

authNativeHostUnreachable.message: native host $HOST$ unreachable ($ERROR$): run NexusBrowser's install.ps1
